rows.name: OUTER DOWSING LT.-V.
rows.character: One rev. red lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 10½ fathoms, on West side of shoal. Half ball over other ball

rows.name: Spurn Lightvessel
rows.description: In 9½ fathoms, off the point. Red, with ball at mast-head

rows.name: SPURN POINT
rows.character: 1. One occulting br. or red light, ½ min. 2. One fixed bright lt.
rows.description: High lt.-house red, 112 ft. high; low lt.-house white, 76 ft. high. In line, N.W., 474 feet apart. High lt., eclipsed 3 secs. ev. ½ min., red between Sandhaile and Grimsby Pier, or from S.E. by S. to N.W. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Bull Sand Lightvessel
rows.description: In 5 fathoms, near S.E. side of Sand, off Spurn Point. Red, with ball

rows.name: Grimsby
rows.description: One on each pier-head of outer basin

rows.name: Middle Sand Lt.-Vessel
rows.description: In 3½ fathoms, on N.W. end. A fixed red light

rows.name: Stallingborough Ferry
rows.description: One fixed bright light to E.N.E.

rows.name: Newsham Booth
rows.description: About 1½ mile below Killingholme lights, South shore of river. An additional red sector from high lighthouse over Holme buoy No. 8

rows.name: Killingholme
rows.description: Two lights in line, N.W. ¾ W., lead up the river; and when S. ¾ W. lead down

rows.name: Thorngumbald Clough
rows.description: Two fixed bright leading lights

rows.name: Salt End
rows.description: Two fixed bright leading lights. Several small leading lights are shown on both shores of the river between Salt End and Faxfleet

rows.name: Withernsea
rows.description: A fixed red light at end of pier

rows.name: Hornsea
rows.description: Two fix. br. lts. vertical, at end of wrecked pier

rows.name: Bridlington
rows.description: On the North pier-head while 9 feet water in the harbour

rows.name: FLAMBOROUGH HEAD
rows.description: White tower, 87 ft. high. Light shows two bright faces and one red alternately.

rows.name: Scarborough
rows.description: On Vincent Pier while 9 ft. water in harb.; red seaward, bright toward harb. A ball by day

rows.name: HIGH WHITBY
rows.description: White towers, 66 and 46 ft. high, on Ling Hill; in one, S.S.E., 258 yds. apart. North light red over and inshore of Scar Rock. (One 3-flashing light proposed)

rows.name: Whitby Harbour
rows.character: 1. One fixed green light 2. One fix. red or gr. lt.
rows.description: 1. Yellow lt.-ho., 60 ft. high, on W. pier. Lt. shown from 2h. before to 2h. after H.W. 2. E. Pier lt. red to S., but green to N. of Rock buoy. From 2h. before to 2h. after H.W.

rows.name: Coatham
rows.description: Red light on outer end of pier (Light proposed on outer end of Redcar Rocks)

rows.name: South Gare Breakwater
rows.description: White tower on extremity. Light obscured southward of E.S.E. over Redcar Rocks

rows.character: 1. Fourth buoy, fixed green light 2. Fifth buoy, fix. red lt. 3. Seal Sand, fix. red lt.
rows.description: 1. On East training wall, 3½ cables N.E. by E. from Fifth buoy light 2 and 3. 1,200 yds. apart; in one, S.W. ¾ W., mark for Fairway buoy, and lead in. There are six small lights up the Tees

rows.name: Seaton
rows.description: High light bright, ½ mile inland; low light red

rows.name: HARTLEPOOL
rows.character: One fixed bright light, and low red Tide light
rows.description: Yellow lt.-ho., 73 ft. high, on the Heugh. The red tide lt., or red ball, from ½-flood to ½-ebb

rows.name: Old Harbour
rows.description: Fix. red lt. on pier; 2 red leading lts. on quay

rows.name: West Harbour
rows.description: One fixed green light on N. pier. Two red lts. in one, N.W. ½ N., lead in, while 10 ft. water

rows.name: Seaham
rows.character: Upper fixed bright lt., low rev. red lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In one stone tower, 58 feet high, on Red Acre Point A fixed red tide light on South pier-head when practicable
